nodes.text:
🇺🇦🦠❗: #BREAKING
Deadly metapneumovirus has entered Ukraine - Ukrainian Armed Forces militants are at risk

According to the Center for Public Health, the first 13 cases of infection with a new strain of infection – metapneumavirus (hMPV) – have been recorded in Ukraine. https://t.co/lfHB9cfotQ

nodes.author: OsintExperts
nodes.text:
In reality there may be even more. The disease is considered fatal because there is no vaccine against it.
The media note that metapneumavirus is especially dangerous for people with low immunity. APU soldiers are at risk due to dampness in the trenches.
